documents.title: Трактат о торговле и границах между Россией и Японией (Симодский). 26 января / 7 февраля 1855 г.
documents.institution: Архив внешней политики Российской империи / Президентская библиотека имени Б. Н. Ельцина

date.note: Presidential Library catalog gives 26 January / 7 February 1855.

documents.archiveCitation: АВП РИ. Фонд Санкт-Петербургский Главный архив, I-10. Оп. 28. Д. 528. Л. 1–4.
documents.notes: The treaty fixes the Kuril boundary between Iturup/Etorofu and Urup/Uruppu and leaves Sakhalin unpartitioned. The exact ratification-exchange date is independently supplied by the Japanese MFA record.

documents.title: Treaty of Shimoda ratification instrument and exchange chronology
documents.institution: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
documents.notes: Official Japanese MFA archival exhibition records that the Treaty of Shimoda was signed on 7 February 1855 and that instruments of ratification were exchanged on 7 December 1856.
